class Bag {
  [key: symbol]: number;
  label = "bag";
}
const key = Symbol("key");
const bag = new Bag();
bag[key] = 3;
console.log(bag.label, bag[key]);

class Mixed {
  [key: string | symbol]: number;
}
const mixed = new Mixed();
mixed[key] = 4;
mixed.count = 5;
console.log(mixed[key], mixed.count);

class Tagged extends Bag {
  name = "tagged";
}
const tagged = new Tagged();
tagged[key] = 6;
const read: number = tagged[key];
console.log(read, tagged.name);
